sonnet.problem: The last story card retells that the boat reaches the shore, which is the answer to the choice card right before it (card 7, 'land at once'). That repeats an answer already shown and works as a recap. The last verse was already asked on a choice card, so the final card should be only the short 'story isn't over' line.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
